name: Kid's Charcuterie Plates with Ham, Crackers, Cheese, Grapes, Dried Fruit & Chocolate Raisins (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Place chocolate covered raisins in a small bowl and place on a small platter.
Wash and dry grapes. Add to the plate with the chocolate covered raisins.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; thinly slice. Add to the plate.
Roll up ham slices, then cut in half lengthwise. Add to the plate.
Cut dried mango into smaller pieces (if desired). Add to the plate along with dried apricots, crackers, and cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup dried mango
½ cup dried apricot
½ cup cheddar cheese crackers
2 oz mini cheese slices (variety party pack)

instructions.primary_message: Have kids design their own charcuterie plates using the items on the platter. Have fun making different combinations and enjoy!
